nodes.description: Boolean flag guarding one-time initialization of sbController, sbStrongPool and strongToken addresses.
Interface handle to the sbController contract, used for community acceptance checks, start day, upToDate and community enumeration.
Interface handle to the sbStrongPool contract, used for serviceMinMined checks and the mineFor payout call.
ERC20 STRONG token handle, used for transferFrom deposits and approve for the strong pool.
mapping(address=>uint96) of raw staked voting balances credited/debited by updateVotes.
mapping(address=>address) of delegatee for each delegator.
mapping(address=>uint32) number of vote checkpoints per delegatee.
mapping(address=>mapping(uint32=>Checkpoint)) historical vote checkpoints used for prior proposal votes.
mapping voter=>community=>service[] list of services each voter supports per community.
Day boundary array of a voter's votes for a community/service pair.
Amount array of a voter's votes for a community/service pair.
Accrued vote-seconds array for a voter's votes on a community/service pair.
Last day a voter claimed rewards for.
Total amount of votes currently allocated by a voter to services.
Pooled STRONG rewards per day available to all voters.
Last day a service claimed rewards for.
STRONG rewards per community per day available to services.
Day boundary array of aggregate community votes.
Aggregate community vote-seconds array used as the reward denominator.
Caller supplied address used as voter, service, community and authorization identity.
Block timestamp used to derive the current day and the seconds remaining in the current day.
init(address,address,address) public: sets the external contract handles once, guarded by initDone.
updateVotes(address,uint256,bool) external: only sbStrongPool may add votes; recalls require self-delegation and available votes.
getPriorProposalVotes(address,uint256) external view: binary search over checkpoints to return historical votes.
getCommunityData(address,uint256) external view: validates community and day then returns aggregate community data.
receiveServiceRewards(uint256,uint256) external: any accepted community can deposit STRONG rewards for a day.
receiveVoterRewards(uint256,uint256) external: only sbController can deposit STRONG voter rewards for a day.
recallAllVotes() public: recalls all of the caller's outstanding votes across every community and service.
delegate(address) public: changes the caller's delegatee, recalling previous delegate votes when needed.
vote(address,address,uint256) public: allocates the caller's available proposal votes to a service in a community.
recallVote(address,address,uint256) public: partially recalls votes from a service.
dropService(address,address) public: withdraws all votes from a service and removes it from the voter's list.
serviceClaimAll() public: claims all matured service rewards up to the current day.
serviceClaimUpTo(uint256) public: claims matured service rewards up to a caller supplied day.
voterClaimAll() public: claims all matured voter rewards up to the current day.
voterClaimUpTo(uint256) public: claims matured voter rewards up to a caller supplied day.
getServiceRewardsDueAll(address) public view: previews total service rewards due.
getVoterRewardsDueAll(address) public view: previews total voter rewards due.
getVoterCommunityServiceData(address,address,address,uint256) public view: external view wrapper over the internal getter.
getServiceCommunityData(address,address,uint256) public view: external view wrapper over the internal getter.
_updateVoterCommunityServiceData(...) internal: applies the vote delta to the voter/community/service arrays.
_updateServiceCommunityData(...) internal: applies the vote delta to the service/community arrays.
_updateCommunityData(...) internal: applies the vote delta to the aggregate community arrays.
_get(uint256[],uint256[],uint256[],uint256) internal pure: resolves amount and vote-seconds for a given day.
_update(uint256[],uint256[],uint256[],uint256,bool,uint256) internal: pushes or edits day entries using block.timestamp based accrual.
_addVotes(address,uint96) internal: credits balances and delegate votes.
_subVotes(address,uint96) internal: debits balances and delegate votes.
_delegate(address,address) internal: rewrites the delegatee and moves the delegator balance between checkpoints.
_moveDelegates(address,address,uint96) internal: shifts voting weight between source and destination checkpoints.
_writeCheckpoint(address,uint32,uint96,uint96) internal: writes or overwrites the checkpoint for the current block number.
_safe96(uint256,string) internal pure: narrows a uint256 to uint96 with a bounds check.
_add96(uint96,uint96,string) internal pure: checked 96 bit addition.
_sub96(uint96,uint96,string) internal pure: checked 96 bit subtraction.
_getAvailableServiceVotes(address) internal view: proposal votes minus votes already allocated, with an unchecked uint96 subtraction.
_voterCommunityServiceExists(address,address,address) internal view: linear scan of the voter's supported services.
_recallAllVotes(address) internal: loops all communities and services of a voter and removes all allocated votes.
_serviceClaim(uint256,address,uint256) internal: computes service rewards, updates the last claimed day, approves and calls mineFor.
_getServiceRewardsDue(uint256,address,uint256) internal view: pro-rata computation of service rewards over communities and days.
_voterClaim(uint256,address,uint256) internal: computes voter rewards, updates the last claimed day, approves and calls mineFor.
_getVoterRewardsDue(uint256,address,uint256) internal view: pro-rata computation of voter rewards across communities and days.
_getCurrentDay() internal view: derives the current day index from block.timestamp.
_deleteArrayElement(uint256,address[]) internal: swap-and-pop removal from a storage array.
_findIndexOfAddress(address[],address) internal pure: linear search returning the index of an element.
strongToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) external ERC20 call performed in receiveServiceRewards and receiveVoterRewards.
strongToken.approve(address(sbStrongPool), rewards) followed by sbStrongPool.mineFor(...) external calls in _serviceClaim and _voterClaim.
block.timestamp % 1 days and block.timestamp / 1 days used to compute secondsUntilEndOfDay and the current day in _update and _getCurrentDay.
sbController.getCommunities() external call used as loop bound in _recallAllVotes, _getServiceRewardsDue and _getVoterRewardsDue.
Unchecked uint96 subtraction proposalVotes - _safe96(voterVotesOut[account]) in _getAvailableServiceVotes can underflow.
Unchecked arithmetic 100 - sbCommunityInterface(community).getMinerRewardPercentage() in vote can underflow for percentages above 100.
External calls to sbCommunityInterface(community).getMinerRewardPercentage(), serviceAccepted(service) and sbStrongPool.serviceMinMined(service) inside vote.
amount argument of vote(address,address,uint256).
currentDay local computed in vote from _getCurrentDay().
rawAmount argument of updateVotes(address,uint256,bool), narrowed with _safe96.
rewards local in _serviceClaim holding the payout amount.
day argument of serviceClaimUpTo(uint256).
dayLastClaimedFor local used in serviceClaimAll().
community address argument of vote(address,address,uint256).
service address argument of vote(address,address,uint256).

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal address(sbStrongPool) for updateVotes to add or subtract votes.
The caller of receiveServiceRewards is treated as the reward paying community and is checked with communityAccepted.
msg.sender must be address(sbController) for receiveVoterRewards.
msg.sender is the voter whose votes and voterCommunityServices entries are updated in vote.
msg.sender is the voter recalling votes in recallVote.
msg.sender is the voter dropping a service in dropService.
msg.sender is the voter whose outstanding votes are recalled by recallAllVotes.
msg.sender is the delegator whose delegatee is changed by delegate.
msg.sender is the service claiming rewards in serviceClaimAll.
msg.sender is the voter claiming rewards in voterClaimAll.
block.timestamp determines secondsSinceStartOfDay and therefore the vote-seconds accrual written by _update.
block.timestamp is divided by 1 days to derive the current day in _getCurrentDay.
The currentDay returned by _getCurrentDay is passed as the currentDay argument of _update.
_updateVoterCommunityServiceData delegates the array mutation to _update.
_updateServiceCommunityData delegates the array mutation to _update.
_updateCommunityData delegates the array mutation to _update.
_update pushes or edits the voter/community/service day arrays.
_update pushes or edits the amount arrays.
_update pushes or edits the vote-seconds arrays.
vote records the new allocation in the voter/community/service arrays.
vote records the new allocation in the service/community arrays.
vote records the new allocation in the aggregate community arrays.
vote increments voterVotesOut[msg.sender] by the voted amount.
recallVote decreases the voter/community/service allocation.
recallVote decreases the service/community allocation.
recallVote decreases the aggregate community allocation.
dropService removes the full allocation from the voter/community/service arrays.
dropService removes the full allocation from the service/community arrays.
dropService removes the full allocation from the aggregate community arrays.
_recallAllVotes zeroes each voter/community/service allocation.
_recallAllVotes zeroes each service/community allocation.
_recallAllVotes zeroes each aggregate community allocation.
_addVotes increases balances[voter] through _add96.
_subVotes decreases balances[voter] through _sub96.
_addVotes triggers _moveDelegates via _addDelegates.
_subVotes triggers _moveDelegates via _subtactDelegates.
_delegate calls _moveDelegates to shift the delegator balance.
_moveDelegates writes the recomputed voting weight through _writeCheckpoint.
_writeCheckpoint stores the new vote total in checkpoints[delegatee].
_writeCheckpoint increments numCheckpoints[delegatee].
_serviceClaim obtains the payout via _getServiceRewardsDue.
_getServiceRewardsDue reads communityDayRewards[community][day] as the reward pool.
_voterClaim obtains the payout via _getVoterRewardsDue.
_getVoterRewardsDue reads dayVoterRewards[day] as the reward pool.
_serviceClaim performs approve plus sbStrongPool.mineFor external calls after updating serviceDayLastClaimedFor.
_voterClaim performs approve plus sbStrongPool.mineFor external calls after updating voterDayLastClaimedFor.
receiveServiceRewards calls strongToken.transferFrom before writing communityDayRewards for the sender.
receiveVoterRewards calls strongToken.transferFrom before adding to dayVoterRewards.
receiveServiceRewards queries sbController.communityAccepted(msg.sender).
receiveServiceRewards pulls tokens with strongToken.transferFrom.
receiveVoterRewards pulls tokens with strongToken.transferFrom.
vote validates the community with sbController.communityAccepted.
vote requires sbStrongPool.serviceMinMined(service).
vote makes external calls into the community contract and the strong pool before mutating its own state.
vote computes 100 - getMinerRewardPercentage() with unchecked arithmetic.
_getAvailableServiceVotes subtracts voterVotesOut from proposalVotes as unchecked uint96 arithmetic.
_getAvailableServiceVotes reads voterVotesOut[account].
_getAvailableServiceVotes reads the latest checkpoint through _getCurrentProposalVotes.
_update derives secondsUntilEndOfDay from block.timestamp, making reward accrual timestamp dependent.
_getCurrentDay derives the day index from block.timestamp, making claim windows timestamp dependent.
_recallAllVotes uses sbController.getCommunities() as an unbounded external loop over all communities.
_getServiceRewardsDue repeatedly calls sbController.getCommunities() inside the day loop.
_getVoterRewardsDue repeatedly calls sbController.getCommunities() inside the day loop.
updateVotes takes the adding path and calls _addVotes.
updateVotes takes the removing path and calls _subVotes.
delegate forwards to the internal _delegate.
delegate recalls the previous delegate's outstanding votes with _recallAllVotes.
dropService locates the service index with _findIndexOfAddress.
dropService removes the service entry with _deleteArrayElement.
getVoterCommunityServiceData forwards the read to the internal voter/community/service getter logic.
getServiceCommunityData forwards the read to the internal service/community getter logic.
_updateVoterCommunityServiceData reads historical values through _get.
_updateServiceCommunityData reads historical values through _get.
_updateCommunityData reads historical values through _get.
The amount parameter of vote is validated and applied to the vote records.
The community parameter of vote selects the reward pool and interfaces queried.
The service parameter of vote is pushed into voterCommunityServices and updated.
vote's currentDay local is forwarded into _updateVoterCommunityServiceData.
The rewards local of _serviceClaim is the amount approved and forwarded to mineFor.
serviceClaimAll's dayLastClaimedFor local bounds the reward computation window.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only inside vote(address,address,uint256); it should be merged into the vote function node.
currentDay is derived and consumed entirely within vote before being forwarded to the update helpers.
The rawAmount parameter is narrowed by _safe96 and only used by updateVotes; merge into updateVotes.
The rewards local is computed and forwarded to approve/mineFor inside _serviceClaim.
The day parameter determines the claim window of serviceClaimUpTo and has no independent semantic role.
The dayLastClaimedFor local is a transient bookkeeping value inside serviceClaimAll.
The community parameter is only meaningful inside vote for validating and indexing community state.
The service parameter is only meaningful inside vote for validating and indexing service state.
